description: This file defines the class DeleteFeaturePropertyResponse, which models the response to a delete feature property command in an Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and provides access to the deleted feature's ID and property pointer.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertyResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a delete feature property command, capable of being serialized/deserialized to JSON, containing details like the feature ID and JSON pointer of the deleted property.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DeleteFeaturePropertyResponse with specified parameters, now typed with ThingId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON object or string into a DeleteFeaturePropertyResponse, extracting relevant fields.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing associated with this response.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature whose property was deleted.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the property that was deleted.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Builds the JSON pointer resource path in the response payload.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends JSON representation of the response's payload for serialization.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of this response with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on thingId, featureId, propertyPointer, and superclass fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash based on object fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the object.
